verdict.rationale: The CRA documents its own delegated-access mechanism: representatives request online access through the Represent a Client portal, account holders can "authorize access to online information", and representatives can file returns or make payments for clients. Nothing in the pack spells out the specific authorization forms, the defined roles or access levels, or which actions and signatures must remain personal to the taxpayer. missing for 10: named authorization forms, published role/access-level definitions, explicit list of actions a representative may not perform, rules on which signatures stay personal, independent corroboration
